purpose: One-frame, two-subject blocking measurement pilot. No backend wiring and no legacy/generated blocking-dna modification.

provenance.evidence_origin: The persisted PNG is the byte-identical two-pass imageio+FFMPEG extraction recorded in ghibli_01_v1_multi_frame_pilot.json.

scene_observation.observation: A left-side figure reaches toward the carried bundle held by the right-side figure. The two visible figures form one direct hand-off interaction.

character_measurements.selection_basis: Committed source candidate cc_005 identifies the right-third subject; this is the existing PHASE-689 measurement reused without alteration.
character_measurements.visible_subject_description: Right-side figure holding the bundle; body/head silhouette only, excluding the separately held bundle.
character_measurements.depth_layer_basis: Qualitative direct visual scene-reading from relative visible scale; not a measured z-value.

character_measurements.selection_basis: The second visible figure participates in the directly observed hand-off and is not merged with the right-side subject.
character_measurements.visible_subject_description: Left-side figure reaching toward the bundle. Bounds cover only the visible silhouette; flowers occlude its lower body and are not included.
character_measurements.depth_layer_basis: Qualitative direct visual scene-reading from smaller scale and foreground-flower occlusion; not a measured z-value.
character_measurements.limitations: The lower silhouette is occluded by flowers. The box stops at the last directly visible body boundary; no hidden-body extent was inferred.
